def test_file_name_check():
    # nonce:769f7f8f
    # Valid simple names
    assert file_name_check("example.txt") == 'Yes'

    # Invalid suffixes
    assert file_name_check("s1sdf3.asd") == 'No'

    assert file_name_check("1example.dll") == 'No'
    assert file_name_check("_test.txt") == 'No'
    assert file_name_check("2name.exe") == 'No'

    # More than one dot / malformed structure
    assert file_name_check("my.file.txt") == 'No'
    assert file_name_check(".exe") == 'No'      # empty name part
    assert file_name_check("justaname") == 'No' # no dot at all
    assert file_name_check("") == 'No'

    # Digit count rules (max 3 digits in name part)
    assert file_name_check("MY16FILE3.exe") == 'Yes'   # 3 digits
    assert file_name_check("x1y2z3.dll") == 'Yes'      # 3 digits
    assert file_name_check("a1234.txt") == 'No'        # 4 digits
    assert file_name_check("His12FILE92.exe") == 'No'  # 4 digits
    assert file_name_check("w0w.exe") == 'Yes'         # 1 digit
    assert file_name_check("nodigits.exe") == 'Yes'    # 0 digits
